---
title: "A Down-Week Hike at Rancho San Antonio"
description: "Two hours at Rancho San Antonio before an evening flight: 6.26mi with 736ft EG on foot instead of a run, because CoachClaude had me on a down week."
author: Ben
date: "2026-07-31"
image: "image-14.jpeg"
---

Had a couple of hours on Friday morning before my evening flight home, and for once I didn't run. CoachClaude had me on a down week, so the prescription was walking only, and I spent it back on the [Rancho San Antonio](https://www.openspace.org/preserves/rancho-san-antonio) trails in Cupertino instead. First time here since [a trail run in March last year](/posts/20250302-rancho-san-antonio-trail-run/)!

Total 6.26mi with 736ft EG, walking at 17-20 min/mi with HR 83-98 (avg 90, max 109) -- real EZ! Started at 07:39 in 62°F and finished before the heat, on the fifth straight 90°F+ day here.

Along the hike: wild turkeys under the oaks and strutting across the parking lot, mama and baby deer in the creek gully, goats and chickens at Deer Hollow Farm, the historic Grant Cabin, and the St. Joseph's College marker out in the dry meadow.
